title: Going down for an integral extension of a normal domain
statement: Let $A\subseteq B$ be a subring of a commutative ring, with $A$ and $B$ integral domains. Assume that $A$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] (integrally closed in its field of fractions) and that $B$ is integral over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] (every element of $B$ is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in $A$). Let $\mathfrak p\subseteq\mathfrak p'$ be prime ideals of $A$ and let $\mathfrak q'$ be a prime ideal of $B$ with $A\cap\mathfrak q'=\mathfrak p'$. Then there is a prime ideal $\mathfrak q$ of $B$ with $\mathfrak q\subseteq\mathfrak q'$ and $A\cap\mathfrak q=\mathfrak p$.
